name: neoadmin
description: Reusable Bootstrap admin template built with TypeScript, modular SCSS, Pug, and Vite

scripts.build:theme: tsc --target ES2020 --module none --strict --skipLibCheck --lib ES2020,DOM --outFile docs/assets/js/neoadmin-theme.js src/ts/neoadmin-theme.ts
scripts.pug:examples: node --input-type=module -e "import pug from 'pug'; import { readdirSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const source = 'src/pug'; const output = 'node_modules/.cache/neoadmin-pug-preview'; mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true }); for (const name of readdirSync(source)) if (name.endsWith('.pug')) writeFileSync(output + '/' + name.slice(0, -4) + '.html', pug.renderFile(source + '/' + name, { pretty: true })); for (const name of readdirSync(output)) copyFileSync(output + '/' + name, 'docs/' + name)"
scripts.build:universal: tsc && vite build --mode universal && npm run build:theme && npm run build:icons && npm run pug:examples
scripts.build:vue: tsc && vite build --mode vue && npm run build:theme && npm run build:icons && npm run pug:examples

author: César R.
